races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden
races.verdict:
Joseph O'Brien is having such a good season numerically and it would be no surprise were he to saddle another winning newcomer in TOGETHERWEAREFREE. Diamonds And Dames can benefit for her debut and chase the selection home, with Mirren seeing out the places.

  1. TOGETHERWEAREFREE (IRE)
  2. DIAMONDS AND DAMES (IRE)
  3. MIRREN

races.name: Book Tickets Online At www.corkracecourse.ie Apprentice Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
DUE IN JUNE is in better heart than her recent form figures suggest and she's eased to a tempting mark on the pick of her qualifying runs. She could be the answer in what looks a competitive 3-y-o handicap, with Cause I Like You and Sayonara heading the dangers.

  1. DUE IN JUNE
  2. CAUSE I LIKE YOU (IRE)
  3. SAYONARA (IRE)

races.name: Glenvale Stud Race
races.verdict:
GLENEAGLE BAY and Bella Isabella are favoured by these terms with the former shading the vote. Bamako Beach looks the pick of the 3-y-os and also needs considering.

  1. GLENEAGLE BAY (IRE)
  2. BELLA ISABELLA (IRE)
  3. BAMAKO BEACH (IRE)

races.name: Coolmore Stud Little Big Bear Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Group 3)
races.verdict:
CATALINA DELCARPIO was disappointing at Royal Ascot but the form of her previous win in the Amethyst Stakes would set the standard here and she can be given another chance to get back on track. Dancing Saxon has been consistent this year and shaped well over an inadequate 6f last time so is also considered, with Magny Cours and Pivotal Attack completing the shortlist

  1. CATALINA DELCARPIO (IRE)
  2. DANCING SAXON (IRE)
  3. MAGNY COURS (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Abergwaun Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
ROSIE FRITH proved better than ever when landing a Curragh handicap last time and she looks well worth her place back in this higher grade. The 3-y-o is taken to get the better of Gazelle d'Or, who has returned to form on her last 2 starts, with Kendall Roy another to consider returned to this course.

  1. ROSIE FRITH (IRE)
  2. GAZELLE D'OR (IRE)
  3. KENDALL ROY

races.name: Cork Maiden
races.verdict:
A huge field but only a handful make any serious appeal. Preference is for OTSANA, who shaped with considerable promise when fifth at the Curragh on debut last month and now drops to 6f. She can get the better of Saint Agatha, who is yet to progress from her debut, but a first-time tongue tie could be just what's required. Noble Irish and Inform are newcomers representing powerful connections so they complete the shortlist.

  1. OTSANA (IRE)
  2. SAINT AGATHA (IRE)
  3. NOBLE IRISH (IRE)

races.name: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict:
With significant rain forecast, it could be worth giving JUSTENZIA another chance off a handy mark. Nancee Spain looks to have plenty in her favour and should go well. Ohmali and Preparations are other notable dangers in a wide-open handicap, while reserve runner Beauvallon would be very interesting if lining up.

  1. JUSTENZIA (IRE)
  2. NANCEE SPAIN (IRE)
  3. OHMALI (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Silver Cup Handicap
races.verdict:
GALYX is worth another chance to confirm the promise of his Sandown run with conditions in his favour this time. Unexposed 3-y-o Bay of Myths is bred to be much better than an opening mark of 79 so he is potentially a massive threat, while the strong-travelling Impartiality is surely going to come good soon.

  1. GALYX (IRE)
  2. BAY OF MYTHS (IRE)
  3. IMPARTIALITY

races.name: William Hill Beverley Bullet Sprint Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
JM JUNGLE is arguably the class act in the field, and he's fancied to open his account for the season. Shagraan won this corresponding event in 2025 and may well be in the shake-up again if overcoming stall 11. The progressive 4-y-o Fluorescence could be an interesting each-way angle into the race.

  1. JM JUNGLE (IRE)
  2. SHAGRAAN (IRE)
  3. FLUORESCENCE

races.name: Churchill Tyres EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PIVOTAL VOYAGE makes appeal on paper (half-sister to a couple that won on debut) and has a handy draw for her racecourse bow. She could be worth chancing, with Eleven Eighty Two and Cheeky Chesca the pick of those with experience.

  1. PIVOTAL VOYAGE (IRE)
  2. ELEVEN EIGHTY TWO (IRE)
  3. CHEEKY CHESCA (IRE)

races.name: Ward Homes Yorkshire Handicap
races.verdict:
ON THE RIVER returned to form when third at Newcastle last time, despite coming from further back than ideal, and he can build on that effort to take advantage of what is a workable mark. Next best could be Hot Cash, who looks interesting back on softer ground, while The Sweet Escape would enter calculations if taking up this engagement.

  1. ON THE RIVER
  2. HOT CASH
  3. THE SWEET ESCAPE

races.name: Constant Security Handicap
races.verdict:
MANAGING DIRECTOR has been shaping up well for new connections following a significant absence prior to this season so Geoff Oldroyd's charge gets the verdict to double his tally back down in grade. His main threat may emerge from Harb, who bounced back to form when finishing runner-up at Hamilton recently. 3-y-os Simba's Pride and Qila can do battle for minor honours.

  1. MANAGING DIRECTOR (IRE)
  2. HARB
  3. SIMBA'S PRIDE

races.name: Return Of The Legend Martin Spencer Nursery
races.verdict:
PRINTING MONEY did too much too soon from a wide draw when third at Kempton last time and looks capable of striking here. A 3 lb rise looks fair for last-time-out winner Bella Lucia and she heads the dangers from Court Legend, who now has headgear fitted.

  1. PRINTING MONEY (IRE)
  2. BELLA LUCIA
  3. COURT LEGEND

races.name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Hull Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
SPOOKY WOOKY stepped forward from his return when fourth at Redcar earlier in the month and the step back up to 2m should see him in an even better light. Time Turner and Elemental Eye arrive in good form and also merit consideration.

  1. SPOOKY WOOKY (IRE)
  2. TIME TURNER
  3. ELEMENTAL EYE

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Runner-up on her previous 2 starts, ROCSANE has leading claims to go one better. William Haggas' newcomer Extragalactic could be the fly in the ointment, with Hidden Beyond and Top Cote also worth considering.

  1. ROCSANE (IRE)
  2. EXTRAGALACTIC (IRE)
  3. HIDDEN BEYOND (AUS)

races.name: Bodhi Solutions - Exceeding Expectations In Construction Handicap
races.verdict:
C&D winner ADRESTIA was mixing it in much better company than this last season and appeals most dropped in grade with first-time cheekpieces added. Progressive sprinter Hypnotised could have a big say if lining up, while Kinswoman is weighted to be firmly in the mix.

  1. ADRESTIA
  2. HYPNOTISED
  3. KINSWOMAN

races.name: Bodhi Solutions - Constructing Champions Handicap
races.verdict:
An open-looking contest with slight preference for SOLANNA, who has been in good order for a while and can have his Kempton run 18 days ago overlooked given how the race panned out. Moonjid and Triple Double A are live threats.

  1. SOLANNA
  2. MOONJID
  3. TRIPLE DOUBLE A (IRE)

races.name: Bodhi Solutions - Facilities Management Front Runner Handicap
races.verdict:
METHGAL got right back to his best on just his second outing for new connections when doubling his tally at Windsor recently and, completely unexposed over sprint trips, Dylan Cunha's 4-y-o looks up to defying a 4 lb rise in the weights. Von Krolock upped his game when scoring at Lingfield 12 days ago, so he rates as the main danger, with Insuspense and My Mate Kev rounding off the shortlist.

  1. METHGAL (IRE)
  2. VON KROLOCK (IRE)
  3. INSUSPENSE

races.name: Bodhi Solutions - Commercial Fit-Out Challenge Handicap
races.verdict:
OH SO PERFECT did well to force a strong pace for as long as she did at Wolverhampton on her penultimate start and can be given another chance to build on that effort having again made the frame there in the interim. Campani isn't one for maximum faith given his slow starts but he's clearly on a competitive mark and is also respected alongside penalised Brighton winner Giant.

  1. OH SO PERFECT (IRE)
  2. CAMPANI
  3. GIANT

races.name: Gold & Silver Exchange Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
PIAZZA arrives at the top of her game and with the step up to 1m expected to bring about further improvement, hopes are high that she can follow up from Kempton. Fellow last-time-out scorer Ecclefechan is the obvious threat, while Meritocratic will test the skills of James Owen but he will doubtless come good for that yard.

  1. PIAZZA
  2. ECCLEFECHAN
  3. MERITOCRATIC (IRE)

races.name: Tattersalls EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
FLIGHT TRACKER has a fine pedigree and shaped promisingly on debut when only narrowly denied at Sandown early in the month. He would be fancied to go one better if taking up this engagement, while Mister Whippy can go well after his improved effort last time. Somerton is another one to note on the back of his first run.

  1. FLIGHT TRACKER
  2. MISTER WHIPPY (USA)
  3. SOMERTON (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet Handicap
races.verdict:
SILCA BAY has taken his form up a notch this season, making it 2 wins from 3 starts when successful at Newmarket in July, and he can add to his tally having not been seen to best effect last time. Inspired arrives in good heart and could be the main danger, ahead of Rhoscolyn if he takes up this engagement.

  1. SILCA BAY
  2. INSPIRED (IRE)
  3. RHOSCOLYN

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
PUROSANGUE hasn't been long with the Robert Cowell yard and may well have a decent pot in him. Clive Cox has a strong hand with Fast Track Harry and Flash Harry, who won this corresponding event 12 months ago. Lakers, Rapper's Delight and Fandom are others to consider in a competitive renewal.

  1. PUROSANGUE
  2. FAST TRACK HARRY
  3. FLASH HARRY

races.name: Virgin Bet Prestige Fillies' Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
The largest field since subsequent 1000 Guineas winner Billesdon Brook was successful in 2017 and her stable can strike with APEROLL, who has acquitted herself well in a higher grade since making a winning debut. Once-raced Coaxed is bred to be the part on paper but may have to settle for second best, with Nuit d'Eclair also entitled to be in the mix. Light Of Dawn and Bayside View are also others to consider in an open renewal.

  1. APEROLL
  2. COAXED
  3. NUIT D'ECLAIR (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Selling Stakes
races.verdict:
Not only does GLORYOUS arrive at the top of her game but she's also the clear pick on these terms, so this valuable seller looks hers for the taking. With Echalar having to prove his stamina for this far, Sudbury Hill heads the opposition.

  1. GLORYOUS (IRE)
  2. SUDBURY HILL (IRE)
  3. ECHALAR (IRE)

races.name: City Of Chichester Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SQUIRE DANAGHER made a winning start for his new yard in a race that has worked out well and is taken to follow up. The consistent Personal Best should go well again after a small rise, while Maxident and Senor Cortez are also worth consideration.

  1. SQUIRE DANAGHER
  2. PERSONAL BEST
  3. MAXIDENT

races.name: Virgin Bet Supports Safe Gambling Handicap
races.verdict:
THINTHREAD caught the eye on his second start for George Baker over 9f here last time and he remains feasibly treated on the pick of his French form. It would be no surprise if Bearish got back on the up after an underwhelming effort in a competitive race at York last week, while the reliable A Major Payne can be counted on to go well again.

  1. THINTHREAD
  2. BEARISH (IRE)
  3. A MAJOR PAYNE

races.name: Hollywoodbets Scottsville Welcomes You Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
BULLET CATCH could be the way to go. One Pepper may be the best bet for second, while Good Omen heads up those chasing third place.

  1. BULLET CATCH (SAF)
  2. ONE PEPPER (SAF)
  3. GOOD OMEN (SAF)

races.name: Gallop TV Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
ABBEY'S WORLD just about edges it as the selection. Fleur Delacour is not one to underestimate, while Willow Valli edges it as the selection for third.

  1. ABBEY'S WORLD (SAF)
  2. FLEUR DELACOUR (SAF)
  3. WILLOW VALLI (SAF)

races.name: Bet With Tote www.tote.co.za Open Maiden
races.verdict:
SCOTT'S BAR could be worth chancing. Trip To Venus is second choice, while Mastercrafter might be hard to keep out of the minor money.

  1. SCOTT'S BAR (SAF)
  2. TRIP TO VENUS (SAF)
  3. MASTERCRAFTER (SAF)

races.name: Bet With Colossus Pools Exclusive On www.tote.co.za Class 4 (F & M)
races.verdict:
HEAVENLY MAFIA gets the vote in this open contest. Soho Celebrity is a danger, while Shesha Ntombi is another with the potential to figure.

  1. HEAVENLY MAFIA (SAF)
  2. SOHO CELEBRITY (SAF)
  3. SHESHA NTOMBI (SAF)

races.name: Online Form Guide www.galloptv.co.za Middle Stakes
races.verdict:
VIHAAN'S WEB could be hard to reel in. Donquerari is a big threat, while Cavalry Commander has a place chance.

  1. VIHAAN'S WEB (SAF)
  2. DONQUERARI (SAF)
  3. CAVALRY COMMANDER (SAF)

races.name: Tote For The Win D Stakes
races.verdict:
POURSOMESUGARONME is well worth a look. Global Movement is a danger, while Flamethrower is another with the potential to be on the premises.

  1. POURSOMESUGARONME (SAF)
  2. GLOBAL MOVEMENT (SAF)
  3. FLAMETHROWER (SAF)

races.name: Lucky Fish Fortune Cup C Stakes
races.verdict:
SHE'S A MACHINE can bounce back to form and prevail. Run Forest Run is respected, while Danube is one to bear in mind as well.

  1. SHE'S A MACHINE (SAF)
  2. RUN FOREST RUN (SAF)
  3. DANUBE (SAF)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Bright Future Class 4 (F & M)
races.verdict:
DAWN SURPRISE is in good form and seems sure to go well. Lady Godiva is chosen for the forecast , while Rags To Riches is prominent among those with minor place claims.

  1. DAWN SURPRISE (SAF)
  2. LADY GODIVA (SAF)
  3. RAGS TO RICHES (SAF)
